behaviors.description: Automatic SDK and debug deployments with independent flag controls.
preconditions: Distinct SDK and app/runtime/SDK debug refs
expected: All flag combinations deploy exact expected refs; update adds SDK/debug; uninstall-only adds no installs; getters reflect flags.

behaviors.description: Shared runtime and extension operation causes, including skipped apps.
preconditions: Two apps share runtime and extension; independently updated runtime
expected: Runtime names both requesting apps, extension names main runtime, explicit apps have no cause, unchanged app causes report skipped on runtime update.

behaviors.description: Nonempty previous IDs migrate real application data.
preconditions: Runnable old/new apps with isolated homes and old app-written persistent marker
expected: Rebase install and already-installed update expose old marker through new app data path; ordinary installation does not.

behaviors.description: Update enumeration for missing and changed shared dependencies.
preconditions: Two apps with missing runtime or related extension, or independent runtime/extension update
expected: Every affected app appears for each condition; complete current and repaired installations have no updates.

behaviors.description: Signed remote branch/collection persistence and independent NULL clearing.
preconditions: Prepared signed collection repository and trusted public key
expected: Branch/collection survive process reopen, exact signed app/runtime install, NULL clears each setting independently and together.

behaviors.description: Committed trusted key permits signed installation and rejects unverified content.
preconditions: Signed collection repository, unsigned repository and public key
expected: Verification survives reopen; trusted signed commits deploy; missing-key and unsigned controls fail with GError and leave no deployments.

mappings.rationale: Independent SDK/debug flags and getters, exact prepared app/runtime/SDK/debug deployment sets, update control, and uninstall-only operation types and remaining refs.

Ready traverses borrowed causes while transaction lives; shared runtime identifies both apps, extension its runtime, explicit apps no causes. Runtime-only update exposes both unchanged skipped app causes and excludes their execution.

Native rebase with nonempty previous IDs installs or updates new ref. Old sandbox writes actual XDG_DATA_HOME payload; new sandbox reads migrated payload at its own path. Ordinary install control cannot read it. No deployment metadata parsing.

Separate absent-runtime, absent-related, shared-runtime-update and shared-extension-update installations require both apps in public update enumeration. Exact prepared state and empty complete/repaired controls prevent vacuous matches.

Public setters and modify_remote persist branch/collection on valid signed installable remote. Separate processes reopen before getter checks; independent NULL clearing checks the other setting remains intact and deployments remain unchanged.

Binary public key committed through native setter and modify_remote; reopened verification-enabled remote deploys exact signed commits. Missing-key and missing-signature controls require transaction failure and empty public installed enumeration, without prescribing resolution versus execution failure.
